label: The PathFinder cost
subgoals: Compute the present factor from occupancy plus one minus capacity
Add the base and history costs
Multiply the sum by the present factor

label: Routing on negotiated costs
subgoals: Rip up the net and reprice every resource
Search for the cheapest path on the current costs
Update occupancies so later nets see the new congestion

label: Raising the price over iterations
subgoals: Start with a small present factor that tolerates sharing
Multiply the present factor each iteration
Stop when no resource is overused
